subject: Cyclone Health — multi-year stability & renewal protection request
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@cyclonehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morris <evan.morris@cyclonehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal — request for price stability across 3 years

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model throughput numbers looked promising for our deployment. Our finance team asked for a commercial proposal that gives them confidence for a 3-year deployment across 4 business units. A couple of asks they’ve specifically requested:

- A 3-year price lock (no per-token price increases mid-term)
- A capped uplift at renewal (they want a max increase of 7% year-over-year at renewal)
- A guarantee that renewals cannot include punitive minimums or forced migration to higher-cost SKUs

We understand multi-year commitments come with tradeoffs. Cyclone is willing to sign a 3-year committed spend (approx $2.6M TCV) but need these protections written into the SOW and Master Services Agreement.

I’m attaching a high-level SOW and our procurement checklist. Can Redwood confirm whether the uplift cap and renewal protection are acceptable, and what discount level you could offer on that commitment?

Best,
Sarah
Procurement Lead, Cyclone Health

Attachments: Cyclone_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@cyclonehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — request for price stability across 3 years

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and glad the demo helped.

We can tentatively support the concept of a 3-year price lock and a renewal uplift cap, but both are non-standard and require Deal Desk + legal approval. High-level posture from commercial:

- Discount target for 3-year committed TCV $2.6M: 35% off list for hosted inference, with dedicated capacity add-ons priced separately.
- We typically allow up to a 10% uplift cap at renewal as a standard guardrail; your request for 7% is reasonable but tight.
- Price lock can be written into the SOW for the first 36 months provided there is committed minimum monthly consumption and an early-termination break clause.

I’m looping in Marissa (Deal Desk) and Jonas (Sales Ops). Please share the SOW and any required procurement language and we’ll turn around an internal request for exec approval if needed.

Next steps: I’ll submit a formal approval packet today — Marissa, can you run a quick desk check on the 35% discount and the 7% uplift cap? Jonas, can you pull historic renewal deltas for similar deals?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal — request for price stability across 3 years

Ben — quick Deal Desk note after reviewing:

- 35% off list for $2.6M TCV over 36 months is outside standard threshold; typical multi-year comps at this ARR band sit ~28–32% once dedicated/hosting delta accounted for.
- 7% renewal uplift cap is more favorable to the customer than our playbook (we allow 10% cap in most commitments).
- Price lock is doable but we should include a consumption-based collar: if monthly usage drops below 70% of committed MRR for two consecutive quarters, standard re-price language triggers.

Requesting Exec approval for the following deviations:
1) Approve 35% first-term discount (non-standard by ~3–7ppt).
2) Approve 7% maximum uplift cap at renewal (non-standard, lower than playbook).
3) Approve price lock for 36 months with consumption collar as described.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx (includes modeled economics and worst-case uplift scenarios).

Laura — recommending this go to the Revenue Committee for sign-off; if you approve, I’ll draft the memo and include legal redlines.

— Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Executive approval request: Cyclone Health multi-year concessions

Hi Laura — following up on Marissa’s desk check. Attached is a concise approval packet: customer summary, revenue impact (3-year modeled), and legal redlines drafted for inclusion in SOW. Key asks summarized below for the Revenue Committee / exec sign-off: 

1) Approve a 35% discount on hosted inference list for a 3-year committed TCV of $2.6M.
2) Approve a 7% yearly uplift cap at renewal (customer-facing clause limiting price increases per year).
3) Allow a 36-month price lock with an explicit consumption collar: if usage falls below 70% of committed MRR for two consecutive quarters, Redwood reserves the right to reprice or convert to month-to-month.

Rationale: Cyclone is a strategic healthcare customer expanding across four BU’s; getting them on a 3-year contract with reserved capacity opens up dedicated pool capacity and reduces churn risk. The worst-case revenue impact under conservative uptake scenarios still meets ASC 606 recognition and keeps unit economics within guardrails (see spreadsheet).

If approved, legal already prepared redlines: the renewal protection clause includes a negotiated carve: no forced migration to higher-cost SKUs during the 36-month term, and renewal pricing must not exceed the documented uplift cap. We asked legal to flag any week-of-term termination triggers.

I recommend the Revenue Committee approve items 1–3 with a one-time exec credit cap not to exceed $50k if we need to make amendments post-signing.

Thanks for a quick turnaround — Marissa and I are standing by to provide any additional detail.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx, legal-redline-Cyclone.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Sep 2027 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive approval request: Cyclone Health multi-year concessions

Team — after review with RevOps and Finance I approve the requested deviations with conditions:

- APPROVED: 35% first-term discount for 36 months subject to an executed SOW with committed monthly minimums (collar enforced).
- APPROVED: 7% uplift cap at renewal; however, the uplift cap applies only to list item pricing and excludes third-party pass-through costs (cloud egress, partner licenses) — that exclusion must be explicit in the SOW.
- APPROVED: 36-month price lock with the consumption collar as proposed. If the customer falls below the 70% threshold, we will issue a 60-day cure notice before any repricing.
- CONDITION: Include a 1x executive credit reserve of up to $40k (not to be automatically applied — requires sign-off) for any post-signing amendments that materially change the commitment footprint.

Please finalize the SOW with the legal redlines and send to Cyclone. Ben, you can proceed to provide the committed offer to Sarah with the attachments and finalize signature steps (DocuSign link).

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
